title: Toast
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
logline: Monday. A hand sets toast on the desk beside the pinned letters. A voice says 'Arthur.' Nothing else. The strip never draws her face; it draws the toast going cold beside the refusal.

panels.composition: The bedroom door. A HAND — a woman's, a ring, a cardigan cuff — setting a plate of toast on the desk's corner. WOOD at the desk, not turning. BARNABY.

image.prompt: brush-pen black-and-white, xerox grain, a woman's hand with a ring and a cardigan cuff setting a plate of toast on the corner of a desk where a young man sits without turning, a small dog on the bed
image.notes: The mother: a hand and a voice. Never a face. Says 'Arthur.'

panels.composition: The toast. The corkboard behind it: the three letters.

image.prompt: brush-pen black-and-white, xerox grain, close-up of a plate of toast on a desk with three pinned letters on a corkboard behind it

panels.composition: The hand gone. The door. Wood at the desk. The toast.

image.prompt: brush-pen black-and-white, xerox grain, a young man at a desk with a plate of toast beside him and an empty doorway behind, no words

panels.composition: The toast, cold. Butter set. The dog's nose at the plate's edge. Wood's pen moving on the strip — this strip.
